description.narrative: IFC proposes an equity investment of up to U$40 million, not exceeding 20% of the total commitment, and an additional co-investment envelope of up to US$40 million under the delegated authority framework, in South Asia Growth Fund III, L.P. (the Fund or Fund III), a mid-market private equity (PE) fund focused on providing growth capital to companies across climate solution themes in India and opportunistically in Southeast Asia, and together with South Asia Growth Fund III, SCSp (Luxembourg Feeder Fund) is targeting US$300 million to US$400 million in total commitments. Consistent with its prior funds, Fund III will target mid-market companies in the climate solutions supply chain focused on (i) renewable energy value chain; (ii) energy efficient enhancement; (iii) food security solutions; (iv) resource / waste recovery solutions; (v) water security solutions; (vi) mobility solutions; (vii) smart cities and green building solutions; (viii) tech / digital solutions; and (ix) low carbon transition solutions. The Fund is expected to size its average ticket per company in the range of US$20-US$40 million in 9-12 companies.

The Fund is expected to increase access to PE capital for climate investments and value creation for mid-market companies in India, focusing on climate adaptation, mitigation, and circular economy. There are a limited number of green or climate focused PE funds in the Indian market. Despite the favorable regulatory conditions and government policies for climate finance, commercial investors are still wary of investing in climate-focused funds. In this context, IFCs continued support to help the Fund will help it build a sustained track record in climate finance and demonstrate that climate-focused investment vehicles are commercially viable and attract new entrants into the market.
